property_summary: After any successful call to setOwner, the new owner must be the address passed as the argument; the buggy version satisfies this trivially, but the reference requires msg.sender == owner so the owner only updates when called by the current owner, thus the property holds for the reference and fails for the buggy version when a non-owner attempts the call.
change_summary: Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` statement in the modifier so the check is completely removed.
